operations.title: Entry 1212 — The Two Radial Endpoint Frames Glue by a Kummer Transition
operations.summary: The finite and infinity local period frames satisfy p0=sqrt(K0/K4) p_infinity. Their squared transition is K0/K4, giving one canonical Kummer coefficient line with inertia -1 around each endpoint and +1 around both. Common orientation rescaling does not change the line.

operations.title: Benincasa reports canonical Kummer gluing of radial endpoint costalks
operations.body: Entry 1212 glues the two endpoint odd costalks. The local period frames obey p0=sqrt(K0/K4) p∞, so g^2=K0/K4. This defines one Kummer coefficient line with inertia -1 at K0=0 and K4=0, and +1 around both. A common residue-orientation sign does not affect the line. Thus the endpoint cells are not independent and no carrier cell is added. The remaining gate is physical current/chain activation.
